name: LeafWiki
description_en: A fast wiki for people who think in folders, not feeds. Fast editing. Tree navigation. Markdown on disk. ([Demo](https://demo.leafwiki.com)) `MIT` `Docker/Go`
description: LeafWiki - Self-hosted wiki. Single Go binary, SQLite, Markdown on disk. No external database required.
readme_preview:
Self-hosted wiki. Single Go binary. SQLite + Markdown stored on disk.

For engineers and self-hosters who want structured, long-lived documentation. No Node.js, no Redis, no Postgres — just a binary and a data directory.

![LeafWiki](./assets/preview.png)
